image_prompts.prompt: 4:5 portrait slide, near-black navy background, a single thin amber line like a sodium street lamp glow at the top, large white sans-serif headline 'What one street does at 3 AM', small amber time stamp '03:10' bottom left. Minimal, editorial, lots of empty space. No people, no logos.

1200x627 photograph-style illustration of an empty terraced street at 3 AM lit by orange sodium lamps, a bakery window glowing warm on the right, a fox silhouette crossing in the distance, cinematic, quiet, no text, no people.

rationale: The project already has the strongest visuals: real frames. The graphics carry the headline; the frames carry the proof.
